_comment: Implement's two files. 02-implement.md is the people's glance: QualityLayer writes the summary, the slices, the decisions (only Plan amendments and the build order) and the limits; the build session may add Program design. agents/02-implement.md is the build's own: the task cards, slice by slice (`### Slice N: <takeaway>` with its task boxes `- [ ] T1 <title>`, its file tree and **Validation:**, then one `#### T1` card per box), the Proof order (one line per Done means step of the Plan), the modules, and the record the next agent resumes from and the judge reads; `qualitylayer check` writes the checks. The cards are the build session's to change: a card that needs another file is edited, never amended. No frontmatter. The cards are parsed by core/docs/outline.ts, the notes by core/docs/build-log.ts.
title: required

sections.heading: Summary
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: slices done and running, started at, time so far

sections.heading: Slices
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: each slice's state in plain words

sections.heading: Decided while building
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section from the Plan's amendments and the build order: one line each, an amendment that replaced earlier ones standing for them

sections.heading: Known limits
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section from `qualitylayer limit add`: one line per open limit the build could not remove, with its card; a limit outside the task is also a follow-up with its owner, in the agents' file

sections.heading: Program design
sections.hint: only what the Plan's contracts leave open: one H3 per decision inside the code (a signature, a data shape, the one non-obvious algorithm in pseudocode); cards name these H3s or the Plan's

sections.heading: Task cards
sections.hint: one `### Slice N: <what works afterwards, as a takeaway>` per vertical slice, numbered from 1, slice 1 the thinnest path: two sentences on what works afterwards, `**Depends on:**`, `**Commits with:**`, `**Shared output:**` or `**Release:**` where they apply, one box per card `- [ ] T1 <one observable change>` (ticked `- [x]` when its done lines hold), a file tree as a diff block where useful and `**Validation:** automated: <commands in backticks> · manual: <what a human checks, or none>`; then one `#### T1` card per box, numbered across the task: Objective, Files, Notes, Test first (or Trivial, Qualification) and Done when, which names every behaviour the card adds and how each fails, each with a test, and ends with a `verify:` command; optional lines `**Design:**` (the Plan's contract headings it relies on, in double quotes), `**Read only:**` and `**Red check:** <command>`; **Files** are repository source paths, never task records or the task's draft artifacts, and a change outside the repository is named in the card's prose, where no slice commit takes it; a field wraps onto indented lines
skeleton: ### Slice 1: <!-- fill: what this slice delivers, as a takeaway -->
<!-- fill: two sentences: what works after this slice that did not before -->
- [ ] T1 <!-- fill: task title: one observable change -->
**Validation:** <!-- fill: automated: the commands that prove this slice, each in backticks · manual: what a human checks, or none -->
- **Objective:** <!-- fill: what changes and why, in one or two sentences -->
- **Files:** <!-- fill: every source path this task creates or edits, in backticks, comma-separated; none when unchanged; inspected paths belong in **Read only:** -->
- **Notes:** <!-- fill: what the builder must know that the Plan does not say; none when nothing -->

- **Test first:** <!-- fill: the public-entry failing test and why it fails; **Trivial:** for a mechanical change, or **Qualification:** for existing-candidate verification plus failure-path witnesses in tests/drivers -->
- <!-- fill: the verify command, e.g. verify: `bun test tests/x.test.ts`; above it, a bullet only for what neither the test nor a Done means step proves -->

sections.heading: Proof order
sections.hint: one line per step of the Plan's Done means, `A3 · after slice 2`: the slice after which the step can first run, so the build runs each step as soon as its slice is committed. A line may name several steps (`A1, A2 · after slice 1`)

sections.heading: Modules
sections.hint: when the change adds a module, the `Concept · Lives in · Reuses` table; otherwise omit it

sections.heading: Resume
sections.hint: each slice's state, the next card, the failing test you stopped on

sections.heading: Environment
sections.hint: ports, fixtures and quirks the next agent would otherwise rediscover

sections.heading: Tried and dropped
sections.hint: what was tried, why it was dropped, so the next agent does not try it again

sections.heading: Notes
sections.hint: one line per decision: - T3 (tactical|amended|agreed|judged): <what you decided and why, one plain sentence, ending with "nothing you approved changes" or "changes what you approved: …">

sections.heading: For Verify
sections.hint: what to open, in which state, and how to reach it

sections.heading: Checks
sections.hint: retained in older tasks; new check results go in records/checks.md
